items.title: Six equivalent formulations of relative ampleness
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma gives six equivalent formulations of relative ampleness of an invertible sheaf for a quasi-compact morphism: ampleness, ampleness after restriction to the members of an open (or affine open) covering of the base, the existence of a graded algebra presentation whose associated morphism to the relative Proj is an open immersion, the same with the canonical graded algebra and adjunction map, and finally the same with an immersion in place of an open immersion. The proof records the easy implications, then works from the affine-cover formulation through the construction of the graded algebra and verification that the associated open equals the whole space, and closes the cycle by showing that an immersion case yields the open-immersion case using that ample powers pull back to ample sheaves on closed subschemes.
